exposure: obstetrician-gynecologists' prescribing practices regarding opioid analgesics
outcome: Number of opioid pills prescribed per patient
Adherence to recommended opioid prescribing practices (screening for dependence, prescribing smallest amount, tailoring prescriptions, counseling on disposal)
cohort: A national sample of American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists Fellows and Junior Fellows who are part of the Collaborative Ambulatory Research Network.
finding: Obstetrician-gynecologists reported prescribing a median of 26 opioid pills per patient across all indications, with the amount varying by indication but not by reported adherence to recommended prescribing practices.
